items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I didn’t vote for President Bush in the last election, I did it the first time. Because I am fed up with him

ctx.x: This is a little off the track but what do you feel about the — this is a very small question — state of the country today.

Oh that’s an interesting question. My background is I’ve always been a Republican and a supporter of Republicans. But I didn’t vote for President Bush in the last election, I did it the first time. Because I am fed up with him and I think he did a terrible thing to our country. I think we have frittered away the credit that we had with other nations. I think the country is in very bad shape and I attribute it to President Bush. And I didn’t vote for him the last time and I certainly wouldn’t — well he’s a lame…
Yeah because they went down the tubes eventually.
